Relive the golden era of Bollywood with the evergreen romantic duet “O Kehdo Kehdo Haan Tum Jo Kehdo” from the movie Sachaa Jhutha (1970), starring Rajesh Khanna and Mumtaz. Sung by the legendary pair Kishore Kumar and Lata Mangeshkar, this timeless melody remains a favorite among music lovers even today.
